notes.title: Balance Update is out now!
notes.content:
I heard from many Zombie Slayers is a rough game - hard and with limited number of approaches.
Well, I hope those changes will make you want to play more:
[list]
[*]Weapons gained significant buffs and are cheaper
[*]Less xp is needed for level-uping
[*]New construct in builder mode - floorlight (doesn't collide and can't be sold)
[*]Easier starts with less zombies in first waves
[*]Exploding zombie (Boomer) has now less hp
[*]Zombies now deal increased damage vs blocks
[*]Zombies are stronger if you have too much money
[*]Selling skill points for cash was removed
[*]Sentries and turrets deal less damage, while also sentries cost more
[*]Specter - teleporting now lets you free when under pulling effect of Puller
[/list]
Enjoy Slaying!
Mateusz Makles

notes.title: Hotfix 2020-04-19
notes.content:
List of issues and bugs fixed and other improvements:
- tesla coil can no longer be placed on a turret and vice versa
- fixed zombie collisions so now they won't stuck outside of the map
- flashlight has stronger and wider light

notes.title: Beta Multiplayer activated!
notes.content:
[h3]Have you been waiting to slay zombies with friends?
Now you can! Well, kind of...[/h3]
Beta Multiplayer has been activated in Zombie Slayers. That means it's very buggy and unstable so be prepared to encounter many glitches.
Meanwhile I'll try to regularly update multiplayer step-by-step until full completion.

Have fun slaying,
Mateusz Makles
